mentions.name: Voice-first computing practice
mentions.description: A personal practice of interacting with computers primarily through voice: mapping the phone's Tap Assistance to ChatGPT voice, coding better voice transcription for the computer, and shifting increasing amounts of work to Claude Remote control. The goal is to disconnect eyes from the screen and fingers from the keyboard, enabling more walking, flow, and creativity.
mentions.problem: The author is tethered to screens and keyboards while working, and wants to disconnect the eyes from the screen and fingers from the keyboard.
mentions.source_excerpt: More a practice than a project, but I'm working on using voice as much as possible to interact with computers. This started with mapping the Tap Assistance on my phone to ChatGPT voice, then vibe coding better voice transcription for my computer, then shifting increasing amounts of work to Claude Remote control, etc.
